```python
import polars as pl

names_df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
})

amounts_df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [2, 3, 4],
    "amount": [200, 300, 400],
})

result = names_df.join(amounts_df, on="id", how="inner")

print(result)
```
